current_episode.title: How To Creatively Lead The Transformation Of A Growing Post-Secondary Institution - Winning With Carolyn Campbell, President and CEO of Norquest College

guest.bio_context: Carolyn Campbell has held senior leadership roles across multiple sectors including 15 years as Associate Dean of the Business School at the University of Alberta, where she ran executive education programs. She previously served as Deputy Minister and Deputy City Manager, and began her career with three degrees in art, teaching painting at the university and working as a manager at an art gallery. She is currently completing a part-time PhD at the University of Oxford on board governance of major art museums, focusing on restitution issues.

context.real_quote: People, clarity of vision, and execution. We have the wonderful people that work here at NorQuest. They're exquisitely clear on their purpose.
key_stats: 79% growth in domestic students at NorQuest College over 10 years
5,000 full-time student capacity originally; now serves 10,000 full-time students
17,000 total students including part-time and certificate program participants
30,000 students daily in education district between NorQuest College and MacEwen University
$4 million in planning and development funding from Government of Alberta for Career Skills Centre
Carolyn Campbell spent 15 years as Associate Dean of the Business School at University of Alberta
NorQuest College strategic plan 'NorQuest 2030' created in 2021, recently renewed and refreshed
